desc: Redraw this puddle tadpole as a detailed 16-bit indie game sprite: realistic tadpole proportions, same face, gray spotted skin with pale belly, leaf on the tail, small plain eyes, same pose and silhouette. Muted natural palette, thin dark navy outline, 3-4 shade steps with pixel clusters, deeper shadows under head and belly, highlights on leaf and spots, subtle skin shading. No gradients, no ground shadow.
